declarations.description:
A toolbar that appears over the text a user selects, like the selection bubbles of Notion and Medium, the "Add
comment" button of Google Docs or "Ask ChatGPT" on a selection. It wraps the content it watches; the controls in its
`toolbar` slot are what it shows.

It appears once a selection inside the content is complete (on pointer up, or after a short pause in a keyboard
selection) of at least `min-length` characters, centred above it (`placement="bottom"` puts it below; it flips when
there is no room), in the top layer so no overflow clips it, and follows the selection on scroll. It hides when the
selection collapses or leaves the content, and on Escape. Pressing one of its controls keeps the selection, so
`selection` (`{ text, range }`) is still there in the click handler; a control with `data-action` also fires
`selection-action` with that action and the text.

Alt+F10 moves focus into the toolbar (the convention of TinyMCE, CKEditor and Google Docs); the arrow keys move
between its controls, Home and End go to the ends, and Escape returns focus to where it was. The toolbar is announced
once per selection. Selections inside other components' shadow roots and inside form fields are theirs, not this
toolbar's.
declarations.name: SelectionToolbar

slots.description: The content whose selections the toolbar acts on.
The toolbar's controls: `c2-button`, `c2-icon-button` or any focusable element. Give one `data-action` to have it fire `selection-action`.
slots.name: toolbar

members.name: placement
members.description: Where the toolbar sits: above the selection, or below it. It flips when there is no room.

members.name: minLength
members.description: The fewest characters, once trimmed, a selection needs for the toolbar to show.

members.name: returnFocus
members.description: Where focus was before Alt+F10, to return it on Escape.

members.name: selection
members.description: The selection the toolbar is showing for, or `null` while it is hidden.

members.name: ownsSelection
members.description: Whether the selection lies inside the content (and not in the toolbar).

members.name: refresh
members.description: Shows, moves or hides the toolbar for the current selection.

members.name: handleToolbarPointerDown
members.description: Keeps the selection when a control is pressed: focus moving to a button would otherwise clear it.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: Fired when the toolbar shows for a selection or its selection changes. Does not bubble.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fired when the toolbar opens or closes.

events.name: selection-action
events.description: Fired when a toolbar control with `data-action` is pressed, with the action and the selected text.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Where the toolbar sits: above the selection, or below it. It flips when there is no room.

attributes.name: min-length
attributes.description: The fewest characters, once trimmed, a selection needs for the toolbar to show.
